newsitem.title: UK: UK's Devro offers to swallow rest of Cutisin.
newsitem.headline: UK's Devro offers to swallow rest of Cutisin.

text.p: Devro International Plc said on Wednesday that its subsidiary Devro B.V. has made a public offer in the Czech Republic for the remaining shares in Cutisin it does not already own for 11.1 million stg.
Devro, a Scottish-based sausage skin maker, currently holds 56.5 pct of the shares in Cutisin, acquired in January 1996 as part of the purchase of Teepak International.
At the offer price, Cutisin's entire share capital would be valued around 27.6 million stg. It is offering to pay for the remaining shares it does not already own in cash.
Devro said that under Czech accounting standards , Cutisin's net assets at december 31 were 33.9 million stg with pre-tax profits of around 1.6 million.
Cutisin, whose shares are listed on the Prague Stock Exchange, is a manufacturer of edible and non-edible collagen casings with three plants in the Czech Republic.
